questions.explanation: The first term is 1 and the ratio is 1/3, so the sum is 1/(1-1/3)=3/2.

questions.subject: ALGEBRA_II
questions.learningObjective: Analyze a two-stage arithmetic series error.
questions.stem: Stage 1: A revision computes 1+2+...+100 = 5050. Stage 2: a student says the average is 50, not 50.5. Which stage has the error?

options.text: Stage 1 only, because the sum is 5000.
Both stages, because arithmetic series are undefined.
Neither stage; both are correct.
Stage 2 only, because the average is (1+100)/2=50.5.

questions.explanation: Stage 1 correctly gives 5050. Stage 2 errs because the average of 1 and 100 is 50.5, not 50.

questions.stem: A study group revision defines a_1=1 and a_n=a_{n-1}+2n-1; explain a_4.
questions.explanation: The recurrence adds consecutive odd numbers, producing perfect squares. Thus a_4 = 16.
